summary.text: Court Boice is a Republican state representative from Oregon House District 1 who was appointed in February 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Bret Cecil as his general-election opponent.

paragraphs.text: Boice has worked as a legislative assistant, served as chair of the Curry County Board of Commissioners, and served on the Oregon State Marine Board.
Boice was appointed to the Oregon House to replace Rep. David Smith and assumed office on February 9, 2023.
For 2023-2024, Ballotpedia lists him as vice chair of the Agriculture and Land Use Committee and a member of the House Housing Committee.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
